overview: TradeNest Naturals produces high-grade dehydrated potato powder from carefully selected Indian potatoes. Manufactured in our FSSAI-licensed facility, the product undergoes thorough cleaning, controlled drying, and milling to a uniform 80 mesh texture. This free-flowing powder delivers authentic potato flavor and appearance, providing food manufacturers with a dependable and shelf-stable raw material for diverse processing applications.

As an IEC-registered exporter, we offer reliable bulk supply and custom packaging options for international buyers. Our dehydrated potato powder simplifies batching, minimizes warehouse space, and eliminates raw handling issues. We provide private-label packing, tailored particle sizes, and comprehensive export documentation support to ensure smooth procurement for food brands, commercial kitchens, and industrial processors.
highlights: Free-flowing cream to pale yellow powder
applications: Instant soups, sauce bases, and gravy mixes
Extruded snacks and savory namkeen products
Bakery goods including crackers and biscuits
Savory seasoning blends and dry premixes
Specialty dough mixes and bakery ingredients
packaging: 25 kg multi-wall bags and HDPE containers
Small retail pouches for private label

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated potato powder?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity is 5 kg for standard orders, with bulk supply capabilities available for industrial processors.

faqs.q: Can you customize the mesh size and packaging specifications?
faqs.a: Yes, we provide standard 80 mesh powder as well as custom grinding profiles and tailored packaging upon request.

faqs.q: How is the dehydrated potato powder manufactured?
faqs.a: We employ a 6-step process comprising sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and dispatch.

faqs.q: Do you offer private-label and OEM services?
faqs.a: Yes, TradeNest Naturals provides OEM and private-label packaging options, including retail pouches, jars, and bulk containers.

faqs.q: Can buyers obtain samples before placing commercial orders?
faqs.a: Yes, we dispatch representative product samples upon request to assist with formulation trials and technical assessments.

faqs.q: What export documentation support do you offer?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter, we supply comprehensive export documentation including certificates of origin, packing lists, and commercial invoices.
